title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population under peer influence, policies, media messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among their social network neighbors and update adoption probability based on social norms and susceptibility.

interactions.name: household_and_workplace_influence
interactions.description: Higher-frequency contacts within households and workplaces increase observation and normative pressure.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and enforcement agents apply mask requirements; noncompliance may result in denial of entry or fines, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: media_broadcast
interactions.description: Media outlets broadcast messages that modify risk perception and trust, influencing adoption with reach and bias.

interactions.name: government_campaign
interactions.description: Government runs public health campaigns that shift beliefs and set mandates influencing locations and individuals.

interactions.name: retail_supply_chain
interactions.description: Retailers sell masks to individuals subject to inventory and price; shortages constrain adoption even if willingness is high.

interactions.name: public_observation
interactions.description: Observed compliance at public locations feeds back into perceived norms and influences adoption probability.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent
metrics.description: Days until overall adoption reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption over the final 14 days, indicating persistence.

metrics.name: compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average compliance (mask wearing) within each location category (workplace, transit, retail, etc.).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality of adoption across demographic groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index).

metrics.name: average_fines_per_capita
metrics.description: Mean number of fines issued per person over the simulation.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Total number of days when any retailer’s inventory fell below a shortage threshold.

metrics.name: average_out_of_pocket_cost
metrics.description: Average cumulative spending on masks per person.

validation_criteria.name: nonnegative_inventory_constraint
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory levels must remain >= 0 throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change over the final 7 days is below 1 percentage point, indicating steady state.

validation_criteria.name: s_curve_diffusion_pattern
validation_criteria.description: Adoption trajectory approximates an S-shaped curve under baseline parameters (increasing acceleration then deceleration).

validation_criteria.name: policy_response_sensitivity
validation_criteria.description: Strengthening policy parameters should weakly increase adoption (positive monotonic sensitivity).
